name: the-idle-deadline-spares-only-authenticated-clients
description: Fifteen seconds after its accept a connection is cancelled, with no reply and no close frame, unless it is an authenticated protocol client: a silent socket, an upgraded one that never said hello and a hook post still uploading are all dropped, and an authenticated client lives on. A deadline for a connection already gone does nothing.
reason: A client that opens a socket and says nothing must not pin resources, and one that has not authenticated by now never will (HK-255).
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: Tests/PowerUpTests/ListenerScenarioTests.swift testEveryListenerScenario plays every step through the bridge (CoreBridge.ListenerPolicy), and ProtocolServerTests drives the same policy over a real loopback socket.
